result.title: Clocks all the way down: does sequence-processing AI need endogenous temporal structure?
result.summary: Mainstream sequence-processing AI is temporally reactive: each update is driven by input and learned state transitions, rather than by an independently evolving internal temporal reference. Biological brains, by contrast, continuously generate rhythmic activity that structures perception, memory, and cognition, and this rhythmicity reaches all the way to behavior. We ask whether this difference is merely implementational or genuinely computational. Four lines of evidence suggest that endogenous temporal structure supports putative functions that input-driven architectures may not readily replicate: 1) phase-dependent routing of information, 2) delay-structured combinatorial representation, 3) cross-frequency multiplexing of items, and 4) oscillation-gated offline consolidation. A proof-of-concept delay-ablation test dissociates representational capacity from memory retrieval. In recurrent and spatial spiking networks with fixed synaptic weights and connectivity, shuffling delays preserves part of the capacity but substantially impairs the sequence retrieval. The relative contrast is more pronounced for spatial networks and longer propagations. Instantaneous transmission collapses capacity itself. We then outline a cross-frequency multiplexing scheme that combines item identity and serial order with alternative mechanisms for selective memory retrieval. Finally, we state one falsifiable hypothesis, conditions for matched-resource tests, and three research directions: the components already exist; the disciplined comparison does not.

AI.brief_summary: 论文追问序列处理 AI 是否需要独立于输入的内生时间结构，梳理相位路由、延迟组合表征、跨频复用与振荡门控离线巩固四条证据，并在固定突触权重与连接的循环/空间脉冲网络中做延迟消融，区分表征容量与记忆检索能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「延迟与振荡驱动内部状态更新、容量与检索可分离」的线索，可供核查 LVR 中循环 latent 状态的维持、取用与信息可用性差异，但该文面向一般序列处理而非视觉多模态推理，迁移可行性需人工判断。
